cards.text: Jesus has just finished teaching His disciples (Matthew 18). Now He leaves Galilee for the region of Judea beyond the Jordan, where large crowds follow Him and He heals them. Friend, I can't get ONE baker to follow me to the oven without bribing them with sprinkles.
Then some Pharisees show up, the strictest group in their religion (Acts 26:5). They came to test Jesus, so friend, this isn't a question: it's a trap with a question mark on it.

cards.question: The Pharisees come to test Jesus with a question. What do they ask Him about?

answers.text: Divorcing a wife for any reason

cards.question: Jesus answers the Pharisees with a question of His own: 'Have you not read…' Then He points them back to which moment?

answers.text: When the Creator made them male and female
When David became king of Israel

cards.text: Then Jesus quotes Genesis 2:24: a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, 'and the two will become one flesh.'

cards.question: Jesus says a husband and wife are no longer two, but one flesh. So what does He say about what God has joined together?

cards.text: Oh, the Pharisees had a comeback LOADED. Why then, they ask, did Moses, Israel's leader, order a man to give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?

cards.question: Jesus answers that Moses permitted divorce because of the people's ___ of heart.
Jesus tells the Pharisees that divorce was the way it was from the beginning.

cards.text: Then Jesus lays it out plainly: 'Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.'

cards.question: When the disciples hear Jesus's teaching on marriage, they tell Him it is better not to marry.

cards.text: Jesus tells the disciples not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.
Then Jesus talks about eunuchs. Some were born that way, and others were made that way by men.

cards.question: Jesus says there are still others who live like eunuchs. For the sake of what?

cards.text: Jesus says the one who can accept this should accept it. Then little children are brought to Jesus for Him to place His hands on them and pray for them.
But the disciples rebuke the people who brought them. Friend, those folks came for a prayer and got a scolding.

cards.question: The disciples rebuke the people bringing little children to Jesus. What does Jesus say about the children?

answers.text: Let them come and do not hinder them
Let them wait until I finish teaching
Let them go home and come back later

cards.question: Jesus gives a reason the little children should be allowed to come to Him. Who does He say the kingdom of heaven belongs to?
Jesus places His hands on the little children before He goes on from there.
